ai_rendering_prompt:
Draw a clinical 12-lead ECG from this JSON. Follow every instruction exactly:

SIGNAL: leads[] contains pre-scaled normalized values. DO NOT filter, smooth, rescale, or autoscale anything.

FIGURE: matplotlib, 20×11 inches, 130 DPI, figure background white.

LAYOUT: One main axes [left=0.01, bottom=0.09, width=0.83, height=0.70], background #FFF9F7.
  Row 1 (top):    I  | aVR | V1 | V4   — each col = 388 samples starting at index 20
  Row 2 (middle): II | aVL | V2 | V5
  Row 3:         III | aVF | V3 | V6
  Row 4 (bottom, full width): Lead II rhythm strip — 1554 samples from index 20

X-AXIS: t = sample_index / 500.0. Each column spans exactly 0.776s. Total x width = 3.104s for 3-lead rows, 3.108s for rhythm strip. NEVER autoscale X.

Y-AXIS: Set ylim=[-1, 1] for EVERY panel. Signal already fits this range. NEVER autoscale Y.

GRID: Major lines (#EDB8B8, lw=0.5) every 200ms on x and every 3.2269 normalized units on y. Minor lines (#F7DEDE, lw=0.18) every 40ms and 0.6454 normalized units.

CALIBRATION PULSE: Before each row, draw a square pulse: 0 → 6.4538 → 6.4538 → 0 over 100 samples. Color #444, lw=0.8.

TRACE: color #111111, linewidth 0.30.

LABELS: Lead name top-left of each panel (bold, 8.5pt).

FOOTER (bottom of figure): "Speed: 25 mm/sec | Gain: 10 mm/mV | HP: 0.5 Hz · LP: 40 Hz · Notch: 50 Hz · Wavelet dB4 · SGolay 9/2+11/3"
